Commentary.Commentary: Moeen Ali and Chris Woakes shared a brilliant stand between them but eventually it was broken when Mohammad Amir removed Woakes. Moeen Ali hit a wonderful knock and got his much deserving century. Some late wickets towards the end handed Sohail Khan yet another 5-wicket haul. After the early trouble, England won't mind 328 on the board. Pakistan could have done a lot better though with the ball. Let's see how their batters respond now.

Sohail Khan walks back with yet another 5-wicket haul but Moeen Ali stole the show in this innings. What a remarkable knock from the English offie, he gets a standing ovation as he walks to the dressing room! England were in early trouble as the top order failed. Wahab Riaz bowled a superb spell early on but Woakes and Ali got things under some control for England.

OUT! MOEEN ALI IS GONE! Sohail Khan bangs it in short and in to the body, Ali stays back and goes for the big pull. He gets a big top edge and the ball skies over square leg. Yasir Shah who is out in the deep comes running in a few paces and takes a good catch. So, with this, ENGLAND HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 328!
From around the wicket this time, it's pitched full on the stumps, solidly blocked off the front foot.
Full ball on off, it's strongly driven to long off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On middle and leg, Anderson looks to play it across but misses it and gets hit on the thigh pad.
FIVE WIDES! Short ball on middle and leg, Anderson lets it go over him. The keeper fails to collect it as well.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Yorker on off, Anderson digs it out.
WIDE! Banged in short on middle and off, Anderson ducks under it.
Shortish on off, Anderson stands tall to play this one.
FOUR! Short of a length ball outside off, Anderson guides it past the third man region for a boundary.
Mohammad Amir is back.
FOUR! Good shot! Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Ali pulls it through the square leg region for a boundary.
On the pads, Moeen looks to play it across but misses it completely.
Fuller length ball on off, Ali drives it to mid off.
Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Ali pulls it away to the leg side.
Good length ball around off, Ali covers the line and defends.
Length ball outside off, Ali plays it uppishly through backward point for a single.
Floated up outside the off stump, Ali pushes this to sweeper cover off his front foot. Takes a single and retains strike.
Leg-spinner on middle and leg, Moeen plays this with the spin and turns it to square leg. No run taken.
3rd Test century for Moeen Ali!

SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Tossed up delivery on middle and off, Moeen Ali makes use of his feet, dances down the track and launches this with all his might. Clears the mid-wicket fence with ease as he sends the ball high and handsome into the stands. What a way to bring up your hundred. A top knock by him so far.
Bowled slower through the air, slightly shorter in length and around off, Ali stays back and blocks it out.

Another flatter delivery from the leggie, around off, Moeen picks this up rather quickly. He rocks back, gets himself into position and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Picks up two runs and moves on to 97.
Flatter leg spinner on off, Moeen Ali stays back and punches it back to Yasir.
YASIR SHAH back on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Full around off, Ali drives it to long on and takes a single.

FOUR! EDGED! Shortish around off, Ali flashes it hard but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies over the gap between slip and the keeper for a boundary. Had there been a fielder, the catch would... probably have been dropped with the way Pakistan have fielded so far in this series in the slip cordon.
Fuller length ball outside off, Ali drives it to deep cover. No run taken again.
WIDE! Banged in short on middle and off, Ali lets it go over him. The umpire calls a wide.
Almost drags it on! Fuller length ball on off, Ali tries to drive it through the off side but gets an inside edge towards fine leg.
Short of a length ball on off, Ali slashes it to deep point. No run taken.
Short of a length delivery which is pulled away hard by Moeen Ali. He connects well and sends it to deep mid-wicket for a single to end the over.
Banged in short around off, the left-hander does well to duck and avoid the bumper.

Short on angling in on the body, Moeen Ali rocks back in a jiffy and pulls it to fine leg. Misbah does well here. On the previous delivery, he felt that fine leg was too fine, so he brought his square and that's saved his side a certain boundary.
Tad short and around off, tapped to the off side off the back foot.
Tighter line from Wahab, angles in a back of a length delivery on off, Moeen still manages to work it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Short of a length ball outside off, Moeen hops and taps it down into the ground on the off side.
Length delivery outside off, Anderson plays it to the pigeons at point. Everybody should get in on the action, eh? Nice of Jimmy to do that. Good lad.
Fuller in length and fired across outside off, Anderson drives this straight back down the ground. Connects well and takes two runs for it. Good shot.
JAMES ANDERSON is the last man in.

OUT! STEVEN FINN-ISHED! It's sneaked right through. Sohail Khan maintains a good line and keeps it just around off, it comes in ever so slightly as Steven Finn goes for the big one. It sneaks right between bat and pad and crashes against the off pole. His brief knock comes to an end. Sohail Khan has taken a 4-fer here.
Very full on off stump, it's drilled through the cover region for one run.

Steven Finn brings out the pull! And connects well too. It's pitched slightly back of a length and around off, Steven rocks back and pulls this over the mid-wicket region. Nobody out there in the deep so he can comfortably take three runs and bring Moeen Ali back on strike.
Fullish ball around off, slightly tailing back in, it goes off the inner half of Moeen Ali's bat to the left of wide mid on. Takes a single as Misbah-ul-Haq runs to his left to cut it off.
Tad short on the hips, Steven works this through square leg and picks up a couple of runs. A wayward throw doesn't do Pakistan much good either.
Back of a length ball going down leg, Finn looks to nudge this away but fails to do so. There was some noise as the ball went past him and so an appeal was made. The umpire isn't interested.

Shortish ball on the body, Steven Finn awkwardly plays at this. Looks to fend it away but gets an edge which goes over short leg. The fielders are way out at the boundary ropes so the English batsmen have plenty of time to take two.
Tighter line from Wahab, pitches it on a length and on off, Finn does well to get behind the line and block.

It's quite full and well outside off, Ali reaches out to this one and smacks it to deep point. Plenty of protection out there in the deep so the boundary will be harder to come. The southpaw will have to settle for a single.
Wahab keeps it on the shorter side, bowls a back of a length delivery on off, angling in and cramping Moeen Ali for room. He does well to rise and tap it down with a solid straight blade.
Quite wider in length and shaping away, Steven still goes after it but fails to get any kind of connection on it.

Almost dragged that back on! A good length delivery outside off, Finn plants his front foot across and looks to smack it through the covers. He gets an inside edge on it which thuds onto his body. That could have easily rocked back onto the stumps. Close call.
Full and aimed at the base of off stump, Finn does well to get bat on ball and keep it out.
Fullish delivery pushed across, it's outside off, Moeen leans into it and push-drives it to mid off. Wants the second as well but will have to settle for just one.

Leg bye! Slightly fuller in length and angling in to the batsman, he tries to flick this away but misses it completely and is rapped on the pads. Sohail Khan turns around and loudly appeals but it's rightfully turned down by the umpire. A leg bye is taken by the batsmen as the ball lobs over to the off side.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, nice shape on that as well, Finn makes a good leave on that.
Wahab Riaz with an extremely full delivery, almost a yorker, it's on middle and off, Steven clips this towards backward square leg for one run. That's the end of the over.
Looks quite organized Steven Finn. Plays this one quite well too. It's fuller and outside off, he bunts it back down the track with a straight bat.
Bumper bombed in on leg, maybe going slightly down leg, Steven ducks under it pretty well.
Fires a fullish length ball outside off, Finn gets his bat down and defends it solidly.
A length delivery which is aimed at the top of off stump, Finn gets behind the line of the delivery well and blocks it down into the track ahead.
Wahab Riaz with a short delivery which is wide outside off, Moeen Ali stands tall and flays it to deep cover for a single.
STEVEN FINN is the next batsman in.

OUT! BROAD GONE FOR A DUCK! On the pads, Broad tries to hit it across but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal for a leg before and the umpire says it out. Sohail celebrates but Broad takes a review as well. It might go down the leg side but replays show the ball is pitching just in line and would go on to clip the leg stump by a whisker. That is umpire's call and Broad has to walk back. Two wickets in the over and England have lost both their reviews as well.
Broad is caught leg before and the umpire has given that out. He thinks the ball is going down leg and hence, decides to take a review against it.
Full and going down leg, Broad looks to flick it down the leg side but misses as Sarfraz dives full stretch to his right to take it.
STUART BROAD is the next man in to bat.

OUT! AND WOAKES HAS TO MAKE THE LONG WALK BACK! No idea why he took the review, usually a batsman knows whether he's nicked something or not. It's pitched on a length and outside off, perfect line which invites Chris Woakes to play at it. He nicks it as Sarfraz Ahmed behind the wicket takes a regulation catch. Chris isn't convinced though and decides to review it for some reason. The decision goes upstairs. Hot Spot shows no sign of connection but Snicko showed a noise as the ball went past the bat. The Englishman is gone and his pacy knock has come to an end.
Woakes has been caught behind. He however doesn't seem convinced and takes a review against the decision.
FOUR LEG BYES! Aimed at the hips this time, it's too straight and Woakes tries nudging this fine down the leg side. It goes off his thigh pad and it goes all the away to the boundary line.
Sohail Khan fires in a full length delivery which is swinging away nicely, it's outside off as it's driven to deep cover. A single is taken.
Length delivery around off, a hint of away shape there, Moeen Ali stays behind the line and blocks it out.
Woakes comes forward and plays it to point.
Defended off the front foot by Woakes presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted in the corridor outside off, driven through the covers.
Full on middlde and off, driven through mid on.
Full outside off, driven to covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Back of a length and just outside off, Woakes just stands tall and punches this wide of mid off. Misbah there chases after the ball and puts in a good slide to keep the ball just inside the ropes. Three runs are taken.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicketkeeper.
Length delivery just around off stump, Moeen Ali plays at this. Gets it off the inner half of the bat and towards mid on as a single is taken.
FOUR! On a length and outside off, Ali throws his bat at this off the back foot. Gets an inside edge which goes past Sarfraz Ahmed. Picks up a boundary.
Back of a length ball around off, it's worked to mid on for no run.
Pitches it full and outside off, Ali drives it to the fielder at cover.
SOHAIL KHAN replaces RIAZ.
Fullish ball outside off, driven through mid on.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.
Flighted around off, defended off the front foot with a straight-ish bat.
On the leg stump, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Pitched on middle and leg, Moeen bends low and sweeps it through the leg side. The ball races to the boundary at fine leg and there is nothing the fielders can do to stop it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! THREE IN A ROW! Length ball outside off, Woakes opens the face of his bat and uses the pace to guide the ball through backward point for a boundary!
FOUR! Another full delivery outside off and Woakes drives it superbly through the covers again. This time too, the ball makes it across the ropes.
50-run stand between Woakes and Ali.
FOUR! Fullish outside off, driven through the covers for a boundary. That brings up the 50-run stand. These two batsmen are really opening up!
Length ball outside off, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! CRACKED! Fuller ball outside off, Ali lunges forward and drives it down the ground and the ball goes to the boundary at mid off. 250 up for England!
Full on off, pushed to mid off.
Flighted ball around off, worked to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, nudged to square leg.
Landed on the stumps, defended to the off side for a single.
Full on the stumps, blocked off the front foot.
FOUR! WELL TIMED! Full outside off, Woakes is at it again, cracking a drive through square. The ball finds the gap and zips through to the ropes.
Loopy ball outside off, defended to the off side.
Full outside off, Woakes opens the face of his bat and plays it to point for a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Shorter ball and wide outside off, Woakes decides to punish that one. He hits it with the meat of the bat and the ball is sent flying through point to the boundary.
Length ball outside off, defended firmly to the covers.
Back of a length ball outside off, 84.8 mph, Woakes makes room and leisurely cuts it through square on the off side for a single.
No ball! Good length ball outside off, played to the off side for a single. The umpire signals a no ball for clearly stepping over the line.
Length ball on the pads, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Short outside off, Ali reaches across and cuts it through point for a single.
WAHAB RIAZ is back on.
Moeen waits on the back foot and taps it to square leg for a single.
Woakes steps up to the pitch again and drives it through the off side for a single.
Full outside off, Woakes steps forward and pushes it to the covers.
Landed around off, defended off the front foot.
Flighted around off,  blocked off the front foot with the full face off the bat.
Tossed up on the legs, nudged to square leg for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, easy leave for Woakes.
FOUR! GLIDED! Fullish ball outside off, Woakes steps forward and leaning into his shot, drives it through the covers. It is beautifully hit and the ball goes all the way to the fence.
Fuller on middle and off, Ali plays a very wristy flick through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, Woakes pushes it to point for a single.
Length ball outside off and angling away, it's a tempting delivery but Woakes shoulders his arms.
Good length ball outside off, Woakes leaves it.
Shorter ball on the stumps, worked to the leg side for a single.
Full on middle, Woakes presents a solid front foot defence.
Tossed up on the pads, defended off the front foot.
Landed on middle and off, Woakes gets back and blocks it with a straight bat.
Floated on leg, worked to backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven to mid off for a single.
Fuller ball on the pads, 86.9 mph, worked to the leg side for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, Woakes looks to play it but the ball shapes in and strikes him on the thigh pad.
BOUNCER! Woakes ducks well in time to avoid it.
Wide outside off, swinging away, Woakes shoulders his arms.
BEATEN! Angled across the stumps again, the ball beats Woakes' outside edge.
Length ball angling outside the off stump, left alone.
Landed outside off, Woakes pushes it through covers for a single to end the over.
On middle and leg, Woakes defends it with soft hands.
Loopy outside off, Ali drives it through mid on for a single.
On middle and leg, Moeen flicks it to the leg side.
Full around off, Ali comes down the track and defends.
Fullish on middle and off, Moeen defends it from within his crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide outside off, Woakes goes after it but misses it completely.
FOUR! Fuller length ball outside off, Woakes pushes it through point for yet another boundary. Nicely timed!
Length delivery around off, Woakes allows it through.
Good length ball outside off, Woakes leaves it alone.
Fuller length ball outside off, Woakes pushes it through the point region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence.
FOUR! Good shot! Full on middle and leg, Moeen Ali gets down on his knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. Confident looking shot!
Landed around off, Ali blocks it into the ground.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Woakes looks to push but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat and through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Ali comes down the track and drills it to long on for a single.
Fullish around off, Ali stays back in his crease and defends.
On middle and leg, Ali covers the line and defends.
Good length ball around off, Woakes blocks it into the ground.
In the corridor outside off, Woakes leaves it alone.
Length ball around off, Woakes pushes it towards point.
CHRIS WOAKES walks into the middle next.

OUT! AMIR STRIKES! Spectacular catch by Sarfraz! Fuller length ball around the off stump channel, nips back in after landing, Bairstow looks to play it to the off side but the ball cuts him into two halves. It goes off the inside edge and to the keeper behind who takes a superb catch going to his left. Amir roars and his expressions show how badly he wanted that wicket.
Fuller length ball outside off, Bairstow drives it to covers.
Good length ball around off, Bairstow defends it from within his crease.
Down the leg side, Ali looks to hit it across but misses it completely.
Around off, Ali covers the line and defends.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Ali defends it into the ground.
Fullish on the pads, Ali tries to play it across but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On middle and leg, Ali flicks it to the leg side.
Fullish around off, Ali gets onto his front foot and defends.
YASIR SHAH to bowl from the other end.
Fullish around off, Bairstow drives it to mid on.
Landed outside off, Ali taps it to covers and takes a quick single.
Good length ball outside off, Ali shoulders his arms.
Length delivery outside off, swinging away, Moeen shoulders his arms.
Good length ball outside off, Ali looks to leave it alone but he's too late. The ball goes off the bottom edge towards slips.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ali pushes it through the cover region for a couple.
We are back for the final session! Moeen Ali and Jonny Bairstow stride out. Mohammad Amir to bowl. Here we go!
...Day 1, Session 3...

The pitch is easing out and is becoming a good one to bat on. Pakistan still hold a slight edge, but with two set batsmen out in the middle and looking solid, things could very well sway in the other direction. The final session will be an important one for both team and will be a good one.

The Pakistan bowlers couldn't inflict much damage. Although, if those dropped chances went the other way, things would have been a whole lot different right now. Yasir Shah was ineffective here as his lines were erratic and was struggling to find some rhythm. Wahab Riaz was the sole wicket taker of session as he dismissed Gary Ballance.

The English wicketkeeper batsman went on score another fifty and is continuing his excellent form in this calendar year with his partner also achieving that milestone. They've stitched a partnership of 90 runs so far and are looking quite solid.

Good recovery by England as just one wicket fell in this session. Jonny Bairstow and Moeen Ali have done well see it through without any further damage. Both batsmen, however, were given a reprieve. Bairstow was caught but Wahab Riaz bowled a no ball, and Moeen Ali was dropped by Azhar Ali in the slips. The duo made the most of the lives given to them by scoring some fluent runs.
Good length ball around off, Bairstow pushes it to point. That will be TEA ON DAY 1!
Down the leg side, Bairstow leaves it alone.
Outside off, Ali plays it past point for a single.
Landed outside off, Ali allows it through.
8th Test fifty for Moeen Ali!
Banged in short outside off, Ali pulls it through mid-wicket and takes a couple. That brings up his fifty as well. Another good knock by Moeen Ali. That's his back to back to back fifty.
Short of a length ball on off, Ali tucks it to square leg.
Full on middle and leg, Ali flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
SIX! Over the ropes! Fullish on middle and leg, Moeen comes down the track and hits it over the mid-wicket region. The ball goes all the way for a biggie.
Landed outside off, Ali blocks it off his front foot.
Tossed up around off, Ali stays back in his crease and defends.
Fullish on middle and off, Ali covers the line and defends.
On the pads, Ali tucks it to long leg for a single to end the over.
Wide outside off, Ali leaves it alone.
Banged in short, Ali lets it go through.
FOUR! EDGED! Fuller length ball outside off, Ali gets a thick outside edge which goes through the gap between slips and gully for a boundary.
On middle and leg, Moeen stays back in his crease and defends.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Bairstow tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Landed around off, Ali defends it from within his crease.
FOUR! Shout of a catch! Full on middle and leg, Ali slogs it over the square leg region. The ball goes safely towards the fence for a boundary.
Flighted on middle and leg, Ali gets onto his front foot and defends.
Full ball on middle and off, Moeen flicks it to mid-wicket.
Landed around off, Ali covers the line and defends.
Shortish outside off, Bairstow cuts it past backward point for a single.
IFTIKHAR AHMED into the attack for the first time. It's his debut.

Keeps it close to off stump and pounds in a bumper, has good pace on it as well, almost close to 90 mph. Moeen Ali arches back and lets the ball sail over him. Sarfraz behind the stumps has to reach high and collect it.
Tad short and on the hips this time, the right-hander tucks it behind square on the leg side for one.
Bumper from Wahab. It's on leg and way above the batsman. Ducked and evaded.
Fuller in length and pitched across, Jonny strides forward and drives it to the left of mid off. Misbah moves to his left and cuts it off.
Short of a length ball on off, JB gets behind the line and punches it to mid on. Gets no run for it.
Tad short on middle and off, tighter line, it's bunted back to Wahab and he collects it on his followthrough.
Loopy and fullish on middle, Moeen does well to tap it to forward short leg.
FOUR! TAKE THAT, YASIR SHAH! Moeen gave that the deserved treatment. It's tossed up on off, Moeen Ali charges down the track and drives it straight back to send it all the way. Top shot!
Shorter in length from Yasir Shah, it's once again well outside off, JB goes back and cuts it to extra cover for a comfortable run.
Floats this one up well, outside off, the English wicketkeeper batsman has nothing to do with that.
Leg bye! Tossed up just outside leg, Moeen Ali gets down on his rear knee and tries to sweep it away. It goes off his front pad and behind on the leg side as he takes a leg bye.
Looped up nicely on the stumps, Ali flicks this to mid-wicket for nothing.
Angling in on the thigh pad, Bairstow looks to flick this away but misses as the ball goes off his thigh pad. He'll feel he missed out on putting that away.
Back of a length outside off, Jonny camps back, hangs his bat out and dabs it to point. Yells "NO" to his partner.
Banged in short on leg, JB has all the time in the world to duck under it.
On a length and aimed at off, Jonny brings his bat closer to his body and presents a close defensive shot.
Full and fired in on middle and leg, almost a yorker as it's angling in to Moeen Ali, he does well to pick it up and flick it through square leg for one run.
Short and wide outside off, JB with an angled bat steers it behind point to pick up a single.
9th Test fifty for Jonny Bairstow!
Tossed up outside off, Bairstow drives this through the covers and takes a single. Brings up his half century with that and it's been an incredible knock so far under pressure.
Some extra bounce for Yasir Shah. He shortens the length just that much and lets it fly. The ball rips off the surface and just beats the outside edge of Jonny Bairstow straight bat. Super ball.
Looped up on off, blocked off solidly off the front foot.

FOUR! Picked his spot and got the execution on that perfectly. Tossed up well outside off, a lot of room given by Yasir Shah, Bairstow skips down the track, opens his body up and drives it through cover-point for a boundary. Beautifully played.
Pitched a touch fuller, still a bit on the shorter side though. It's played with a straight bat to point.
Short and flat outside off, slight width on offer, it's cut straight to backward point.
YASIR SHAH is back on.
Shortens the length on this as it's pitched outside off, Moeen fends it away to the off side to end the over.
Full and fast on off, Ali is early into the drive and ends up spooning it a bit. Lucky for him that it falls well short of the cover fielder.
Fires it in full and on leg, it's flicked down to fine leg for an easy single.
Length ball, angled across as Jonny Bairstow watches it go past him and into the keeper's gloves. The umpire has a look at the landing area once more, Wahab pushing it close again.
On a length and angling across, just outside off, Bairstow stays back and half-punches it in front of covers.
Wahab starts off with a short delivery which is wide outside off, Moeen Ali stays back and flays it to deep backward point. Picks up a single as he jogs over to the other end.
WAHAB RIAZ is back into the attack.

FOUR BYES! Sohail Khan bangs this one in short and going down leg. It's too short though as the ball rips off the surface, leaving Sarfraz no chance to stop it. It races away behind to the fence for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Bairstow cuts this away nicely. Unfortunately for him, it's into the hands of the man at backward point.
Fuller in length and pitched outside off, it's driven hard straight to the man at covers.
Short and wide outside off, Bairstow goes after this one. Looks to cut it away hard but the ball was too far out for him to make any connection.
Full and fired in at the base of off stump, Moeen Ali stands tall, gets big on the ball and drives it straight back down the ground. Doesn't time to perfection but it's enough to get him three.
Angles a length ball across the left-hander, no shot is offered on that one.
Flatter delivery on middle, Moeen whips this in the air through the mid-wicket region. Picks up a single for it.

Full on the stumps, it's bunted back to the leggie. Yasir gathers the ball and fires a throw at the striker's end, seeing the left-hander come out of his crease. Healthy aggression shown there. Much needed in the game.
FOUR! That's timed to perfection! It's tossed up on middle and leg, a lot of air is given on it. Moeen waits for it, adjusts his body a bit and whips it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Drags the length back on this, it's flatter too on middle and leg, Ali gets back and works it to forward short leg.
Yasir Shah bowls this slower through the air, loops it up on off, gets Moeen Ali to press forward and block it out.
Tossed up on middle and leg, flicked to the man at mid-wicket.

He's missed out there. It was on a length and at a good height as well. Bairstow looks to chop this away but the ball goes off the bottom half square on the off side and to the fielder. Dot ball to end the over.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Bairstow leaves it alone.
On a length and outside off, Bairstow cuts this away towards deep point. Runs hard for the first one and as a result, is able to come back well in time to complete the second.
Length ball outside off, Jonny looks to hit it through the off side but misses as he is undone by the uneven bounce. Goes one bounce to Sarfraz Ahmed behind the stumps.

Fuller in length and aimed on middle stump, Ali once again brings those wrists into play. Works it towards Wahab Riaz who is positioned a little deep at wide mid on. Takes him on and beats his throw at the bowler's end as slides his bat in time.
Length ball pitched across Moeen Ali, he raises his bat and has nothing to do with it.
Shah floats this up full on the stumps, wristed through to deep mid-wicket for a single. That'll be the end of the over.
Tossed up on the stumps, shows the full face of the bat to defend it comfortably.
Flatter one from Yasir Shah and it's darted outside leg, Moeen Ali skips down the track and awkwardly blocks it out.
Loopy and fullish in length, pitched on middle and leg, Moeen works it past short leg. No run taken.
Tossed up on middle and off, Jonny Bairstow leans forward and across, makes good use of the wrists and nicely flicks it through mid-wicket. Gets three for it as well. Well played.
Floats this one up on off, Bairstow presses forward and presses it into the track.
In the corridor outside off, Ali leaves it alone.
Fuller length ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball outside off, pushed to covers.
PLAY AND A MISS! Length ball outside off, Ali tries to defend but misses.
On the pads, Bairstow works it to fine leg for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, swinging away, Bairstow leaves it alone.
Drinks break!

That's what Yasir Shah was trying to do in the last delivery. Get Moeen to edge one and he's done it this time. Drifting across him, Ali looks to play at this but gets an edge on it. The ball however flies wide of first slip and rolls away as the batsmen take a couple of runs.
Drifting in on middle and off, the left-hander does well to keep it out and hits it back in the direction of the bowler.
Floated up on leg, a leg-spinner which is going away from Moeen. He kneels down and looks to sweep it away but fails to get any connection on it as the ball goes off his pads.
Yasir gives this some nice flight, pitches it up on middle and leg but it's a little too straight. Ali wrists it to mid-wicket but will get no run for it.
Loops this one up on middle, it's a little too full though and Ali drills it back out to the bowler.

DROPPED! Well, technically that is, but it's so harsh that I even have to say it. Yasir Shah tossed it up just outside leg, Moeen Ali reaches out to it and flicks this hard. Hits Azhar Ali at short leg really hard and he has no chance of catching that.
Good length ball on off stump, Bairstow gets across and defends the ball back on to the pitch.
Fullish on off stump, Ali stays in the crease and hangs his bat at the ball. It takes the inside edge and goes into the leg side. A quick single is taken!
Slightly short outside off, Ali goes hard at the ball with a cut but mistimes the ball to cover.
Fullish delivery on off, blocked away to mid off, on the front foot.
Back of a length and just outside off, Ali stays back and punches the ball to cover. Dot ball!
Length delivery pushed across the stumps, left alone by Ali.
Sohail Khan back into the attack.
Ali has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Tossed up just outside off, pushed away to the covers for an easy single.
Tossed right up around off, Bairstow drives late and finds cover.
Floated up just outside off, defended neatly to the covers. The ball scoots through the gap and two runs are taken.
Flighted around off stump, Bairstow goes back to cut but the ball beats the outside edge. That was perilously close to the edge.
Fullish around off, Ali presses forward and blocks it into the ground.
In the same channel but on a back of a length this time, Ali lets that one go through.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ali does not bother to play at that one.
Around middle and leg, Ali works it down the leg side.
FOUR! That's crunched! Overpitched delivery outside off, Ali lunges forward and cover drives it elegantly through the covers for a superb boundary!
Fullish delivery, angling in. Bairstow flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Ali flicks the ball to the on side.
Another flighted ball on off, quicker this time, Ali closes the face of his bat as he turns the ball to short leg.
Flighted nicely on off, Ali bends forward and blocks the ball calmly.
Loose delivery outside off, short as well. Yasir goes back and cuts to deep cover for a single.
Quick and flat, straight on middle, Bairstow pushes the ball back to Shah.
Flat delivery to start off with, Bairstow goes back and punches the ball to cover.
Introduction of spin - Yasir Shah has been brought on to bowl.

DROPPED! THAT WAS A SITTER! Good length delivery around off, shaping away a bit. Moeen Ali pushes at it rather unconvincingly and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies to Azhar Ali at third slip who puts down a sitter! It couldn't have been easier than that!

Similar delivery, Ali tries to defend this one and does it rather hesitantly. The ball kisses the outer half of his bat and rolls a bit wide of the off stump. Close shave for Ali! Amir is bowling sharp and is right on the money!
Fullish delivery just outside off, very close to the stumps and angling away. Ali leaves it at the last moment. A very delivery that one!
Around middle and off, Bairstow rocks back and works it down to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery angled across Bairstow. He cuts it late and guides it between the slip cordon and gully and the ball zips through to the boundary.
Overpitched delivery outside off angling away, Bairstow drives it sweetly to the covers.

FOUR! Sweetly timed! Length delivery on the pads, Ali plays a lovely flick and the fielder at deepish square leg, who is in a few yards from the boundary can't get to the ball as it races past him to the fence.
A good short ball on off, Ali does well to keep his eyes on the ball and sways away quietly.
Ali is playing away from his body! Another back of a length ball outside off, Ali pushes at the ball as he dabs it away to point.
Back of a length on Bairstow's hips, he clips the ball away to fine leg and picks up an easy run.
Slightly full on off, Bairstow hangs in his crease and defends to the off side. This was a no-ball by Riaz. He's putting in all he's got today, grunting on each delivery as well.
Good length ball on off, Bairstow drops the ball away to the covers with soft hands.
Back of a length and on Ali's hips, he tucks the ball away to fine leg for a single.
Angled in from round the stumps, the ball is not close enough to get Bairstow interested and he leaves it alone.
Good length delivery, Bairstow has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish delivery, Bairstow flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fullish delivery outside off, tailing in. Bairstow gets an inside edge and the ball rolls towards fine leg. The batsmen come back for a couple.

Loud shout for LBW! Back of a length delivery around off, zipping through. Late swing from Amir! Bairstow leaves it and is hit on the back pad.There is a loud appeal by the Pakistanis but the umpire shakes his head. Pakistan take a review. It looked a bit high to the naked eye. The replays confirm that and the ball would have gone over the stumps. Great bowling from Amir!
Jonny Bairstow is caught on the pads. The umpire initially signals as not out but the visiting side isn't convinced. They take a referral against the decision.
Short of a length delivery, banged in. Bairstow ducks under it well and leaves it just in the nick of time.
FOUR! Too straight from Wahab and that's dispatched. Full and angling in on the pads, Ali flicks this through the square leg region to pick up a boundary. An eventful over comes to an end.
Well outside off, the southpaw doesn't bother playing at it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, ripping off the deck nicely and there's some good bounce there, Moeen has nothing to do with that.

AN ABSOLUTE JAFFA FROM WAHAB RIAZ! Serious heat upfront and he says, "Welcome to the danger zone, Moeen Ali!" Bangs in a short one on middle and off, it's a sharp one and it's darted in fast. Moeen Ali has no idea about this and is caught in no man's land. Tries to duck under it but he's left with no chance, is walloped on the helmet as the ball goes off it and into Yasir Shah's hands at backward point. Wahab Riaz looking dangerous.
MOEEN ALI is the next man in to bat.

OUT! BALLANCE DEPARTS! Fullish delivery outside off that holds its line. Ballance is tempted and pokes at it hesitantly. There is a thick outside edge and it flies to Azhar Ali at third slip who bends down a little and takes a good low catch to his right. Wahab did him with a very well executed delivery. Pakistan are on top!
Bouncer! Ballance does well to duck under it and evades it.

FOUR! Nicely done, Jonny boy! Length ball outside off, Bairstow chops away at this. Plays it late and fine and sends it away to the third man fence. Gets a boundary to his name and that's the end of the over.
Length delivery angled across the batsman, he doesn't play at that and sees it thud into the keeper's gloves.

Another beautiful outswinger on off, comes at him on a length, he is once again square up and this time, behind the line of the delivery. Ballance tries to defend it but gets a leading edge to the off side. Gets a call from him partner and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Put away! Length delivery outside off, not much movement here, Ballance opens the face of the bat and runs it through gully to the third man fence for a boundary.

A RIPPER! What a ball, Mohammad Amir! Perfect line and perfect length, just the edge missing there. On an excellent length, just on off and shaping away ever so much, Gary Ballance is all square up as he looks to defend this off the back foot. He is beaten at all ends as the ball barely, barely whiskers past the outside edge. What a delivery!
Amir with a full delivery swinging away, Ballance keeps his bat close and lets the ball go past him.
Short of length delivery, Bairstow goes back and defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Bairstow guides it nicely past the gully region for a couple.

FOUR! Bairstow times it to perfection! Overpitched delivery angling across, Bairstow strides forward and cover drives it beautifully and the ball races to the boundary! That was pleasing to the eyes. Will he make them pay with a big innings?

No ball! HUGE MOMENT IN THE GAME! Fullish delivery, shaping away. Bairstow lunges forward and drives it straight to the fielder at point who pouches it safely. The Pakistanis are celebrating but the umpire calls it a no ball and there is an air of silence after that. Wahab has overstepped by a big margin. That could prove to be very costly!
No ball! Back of a length delivery angling across Bairstow who shuffles a bit and blocks it into the ground.
We have some bad news - Hanif Mohammad, the player who holds the record for Test cricket's longest innings (970 mins), has passed away in Karachi. May his soul rest in peace.
Good length pacy delivery fired in at the stumps, Bairstow goes back and defends it well.
Fullish delivery angling across Bairstow who lunges forward and drives it sweetly to the cover region.
Good length delivery angled in at the stumps, Bairstow stays back and defends it solidly.
WAHAB RIAZ will bowl from the other end.

Mohammad Amir pitches it full and well outside off, Gary Ballance gets down, reaches out to it and looks to drive it crisply through the covers. Gets it off the inner half of the bat back to the bowler.
No ball! Fired in and aimed at the base of off stump, really full in length as Ballance drives it back past the bowler. Doesn't take a run but a no ball is signalled by the umpire for overstepping.
Length delivery outside off, left alone as no shot is offered.
Full and shaping away in the corridor outside off, inviting Gary forward, he does well to block it out with a straight bat.
Pitched slightly fuller of a length, outside off and there's some good carry there, Sarfraz Ahmed behind the wicket takes it a comfortable height.
Slightly fuller in length and going away from Gary Ballance outside off, the southpaw withdraws his bat and watches as the ball goes past him.
Amir comes charging in, bowls a length delivery outside off, some good movement away from the batsman, left alone by Ballance.
We are back for round 2. With England looking to claw their way back, it will be Jonny Bairstow and Gary Ballance to continue, with Mohammad Amir to take the ball.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

Jonny Bairstow, their go-to-man in a crisis is out there now partnered by Gary Ballance. Should be exciting to see how the second session pans out, especially with the sun coming out and the wicket drying up a bit as well. The first session was an amazing one and made sure it caught your interest. And you know the next one will have something in it as well. Join us back shortly for the post-Lunch session.

England lost their top order and were undone by some good bowling from the Pakistan pace department. It can now be argued that Alastair Cook's ploy of seeing out the first hour/session has backfired. The skipper would have liked to see at least two of his top order batsmen still out there as they headed into the break.

Wahab Riaz was the man of the hour. Although Amir was the one who started things off by dismissing Alex Hales, his spell was the one that turned the tide in the visiting side's favour. He picked up the all-important wicket of Joe Root and then sent James Vince, whose bad run still continues, back to the pavilion. Sohail Khan got the wicket of the English skipper who was dropped just moments before his demise. It has been a good session for them.

This match came with the promise of keeping us at the edge of our seats and it has not failed to deliver. England fans, however, will be hanging on for completely different reasons as Pakistan have taken the first session by storm, and it has all been done by their pacers. All three have contributed by picking up wickets.
Bouncer! Banged in. It is too high and going down leg. Bairstow ducks under it comfortably and Sarfraz collects it high over his arms. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 1!
FOUR! Juicy full toss outside off stump, Bairstow's eyes light up and he drives it through the covers as the balls fizzes across to the boundary. He is too good a player to miss out on that!
Almost a carbon copy of the previous delivery!
Back of a length ball, slanting across Bairstow, he leaves it alone.
No ball! Fullish around off, Bairstow dabs at it towards point. Riaz overstepped a long way there so a no ball has been signalled by the umpire.
Around middle, Ballance tucks it nicely behind square leg for a single!
Fullish outside off, Ballance watches it carefully and lets it go.
Bairstow shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Around off, Bairstow pushes it towards the covers off his back foot.
Outside off, Bairstow is in no mood to flirt at that one.
FOUR! Full around middle, Bairstow flicks it wristly behind square leg and the ball reaches the fence very quickly! Bairstow is in good touch!
FOUR! SWEETLY TIMED! Fullish delivery just outside off, Bairstow leans forward and drives it delightfully wide of mid off and the ball races to the boundary!
Fullish delivery wide outside off, Bairstow lets that one go through.
Outside off, Ballance looks to play at that one but fails to connect.
Ballance gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it solidly.

Around off, Ballance goes back and pushes it towards Yasir Shah at backward point and sets off for a single. He throws the ball at the non-striker's end as Ballance just reaches the crease in the nick of time. He looked uncomfortable there!
Outside off, Bairstow does not bother to play at that one.
Full delivery outside off, Bairstow drives it beautifully to the covers.
Outside off, a bit wide. Bairstow lets that one go through to the keeper.
On the pads, Ballance nudges it to fine leg and the batsmen come down for a couple.
Around middle and leg, Ballance flicks it off his pads.
Good length ball outside off, Ballance lets that one go through.
Great delivery! Fullish delivery, angling away, draws Ballance into the drive and Ballance obliges. He pushes at it rather hesitantly and gets beaten comprehensively.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ballance shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Back of a length delivery around middle and leg, climbing up, strikes Ballance on the thigh pads.
Back of a length on the stumps, Bairstow plays with soft hands and drops it down towards the leg side.
Short delivery around leg, zips off the pitch, it is too high and Bairstow ducks under it.
Full length delivery just outside off, Bairstow lunges forward and defends it well.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery!
Around off, Bairstow defends it solidly by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
No ball! Wahab angles this one across Bairstow who lets that one go through. Wahab overstepped on this occasion.
Jonny Bairstow walks out to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! This is beautiful bowling! Short of a length ball around the off stump line, Vince looks to defend it from within his crease but the ball takes the outside edge and to the keeper behind. Easy catch for Sarfraz and Wahab Riaz gets another wicket. England are in real trouble here. Pakistan right on top!
That's a peach of a delivery! Good length delivery around off, zips through the pitch. Ballance has no choice but to play at it and he gets beaten all ends up.
Similar delivery, Ballance does not bother to play at that one.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ballance shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Overpitched delivery just outside off, Ballance fails to capitalize on it and drags it back straight to the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off, Ballance looks at it carefully and lets it go. Good leave by Ballance!
Back of a length delivery around off, Vince shuffles across and guides it behind square leg for a single. Vince gets off the mark!
Another testing bouncer, angled in at Ballance's body, the Yorkshireman sways away from the ball.
Riaz greets Ballance with a sharp bouncer! Ballance wisely chooses to duck under the ball.
Gary Ballance walks in with England in some early trouble.

OUT! Riaz gets rid of the dangerous Root! That spat up at him! Back of a length delivery, lands and shoots up as Root goes back to defend the ball. It takes the outside edge and flies towards Sarfraz who pouches the ball eagerly! Root wanted to pull out of the shot at the end, but it was too late. Two wickets for Pakistan in two overs - that too of Cook and Root. Replays show Root was in two minds as he wanted to pull out at the last moment but it was too late for him.
Tight length delivery on off, Root dead bats the ball right next to his feet with a defensive shot.
FOUR! Played with good control! Back of a length and just outside off, Root stays tall and guides the ball past the diving gully fielder to the third man fence.
Riaz angles a ball wide outside the off stump and Root shows no interest whatsoever in playing at this one.
Full and searing in towards middle, Vince gets his bat down just about in time to keep the ball out. A wicket maiden by Sohail Khan!
The new man in at the crease is James Vince! He's got starts on several occasions in the series, but has failed to convert them into meaty scores. Can he do it in this innings?

OUT! Cook is gone and the happiest person on the ground won't be the bowler or the Pakistani skipper, it will be Iftikhar Ahmed! A shortish delivery around off, Cook goes for one of his favourite shots - the pull. He doesn't get it anywhere close to the middle, instead drags the ball on to the stumps off the inside half of his bat. That's a mighty important wicket for Pakistan!
Slightly full and just outside off,  Cook shoulders arms with ease! The ball doesn't carry through at a good height to Sarfraz!
A good length delivery around off, Cook opens the face of his bat as he pushes the ball to point.
Tight length delivery around off, Cook goes on the back foot in defence.
Tight length delivery around off, Cook stays back and dabs the ball to the covers.
Ambitious there! Short delivery outside off, gets big on Root who looks to play an upper cut. He meets thin air in his attempt!
Slightly short and outside off, Root goes back to cut. The ball was too close to him and ended up going straight to gully.
Fullish and just outside off, Root shoulders arms comfortably.

Cook has been DROPPED! Fullish and just outside off, the ball shapes away as Cook pushes tentatively at the ball. The edge is induced and the ball carries at a low height to Iftikhar Ahmed at first slip, but he just can't get his hands around the ball. This could prove to be a costly miss. A single has been taken as well!
Short delivery, asking to be hit and Root takes the invitation! Problem is, that there is a fielder stationed at deep point. So just a single for that cut!
FOUR! That's smartly done! Back of a length and just outside off, Root opens the face of his bat and guides the ball through the gully region, right in the gap for a boundary to third man.
Length delivery just outside off, Cook shuffles to the off stick and leaves the ball alone.
Another mistimed shot! Short delivery outside off, Cook arches backwards and looks to cut, he mistimes the ball to point.

Cook plays away from his body, but no harm done! Short of a good length, just outside off and Cook looks to punch the ball. He doesn't move his feet at all and the ball goes straight back off his inside edge.
Rock solid from Cook! Back of a length on off, Cook goes right back and defends the ball with a straight blade.
Good length delivery, in the corridor outside off! Root stays back and knocks the ball away just behind point to pick up an easy run.
Fullish and outside off, Root gets forward but leaves the ball which dies down in front of the keeper.
Slightly full and just outside off, Cook presses forward as he blocks the ball to the covers.
Straight delivery this time, Root waits for the ball to come closer to him and clips it away for a single to fine leg.
Back of a length and just outside off, Root hangs back and pushes the ball towards point.
Riaz angles this one on his pads and Cook works the ball away through mid-wicket for a single.
A rising delivery just outside off, Cook leaves the ball and ensures that he keeps his bat and gloves away.
FOUR! Carved away! Shortish delivery outside off, Cook hangs back and cuts the ball through point for a boundary.
Back of a length and just outside off, Root hops a bit as he pushes the ball away to cover. He searches for a single but his skipper turns him down.
A tight length ball on off, Root is forced to put bat to ball here, does well as he jabs the ball away to point.
Another length delivery outside off, another leave by Root. He looks well composed!
Fullish delivery pushed across Root, who lets the ball through to the keeper.

Good stop by Riaz in the deep! Banged in short at Cook's body, he goes for the pull, hits the ball fine down to fine leg. Riaz gets around, slides and keeps the ball from going to the fence. Just one to Cook!
Amir searches for swing and bowls a full delivery on the pads. Cook keeps his feet away and flicks the ball right between deep square leg and fine leg, to pick up a couple.
The umpires call for the first drinks break.
Nice punch, but straight to point! Back of a length and angled across off, Root goes back and opens the face of his bat as he hits the ball to point.
Riaz seemed a bit unsure in his run-up, but continued steaming in. He bowls a length ball on off, Root defends it right under his nose.
There's the bouncer! Not quite well directed, was short and angled away from Root who didn't even have to duck. The umpire stretches one hand out to signal a front foot no-ball.
Riaz goes wide of the crease and bowls a length delivery on off. Root dabs the ball down to the off side. Good solid defence there!

Back of a length delivery on off, Cook goes up on his toes and flicks the ball away to deep square leg. There are two fielders deep in the leg side, one where the ball went to just now and the other at fine leg.
Tight line and length on middle and off. Cook goes on the back foot and turns the ball into the leg side.
Riaz starts off with a back of a length delivery outside off. Cook stands tall and doesn't fiddle with it.

Wahab Riaz comes in to bowl after being picked back into the side. Can he prove the selectors that he should've been part of the side in the third Test? Don't forget he had made his debut at The Oval and had taken a five-fer as well.
Amir is not able to get the ball in, yet! Fullish and just outside off, Root keeps a close eye on the ball as he presses forward and allows the ball through.
Full delivery angled across Root, who leaves the ball alone.
Cook takes the bait this time, the result goes in his favour! Fullish outside off, Cook gets his front foot across and drives the ball neatly through cover. Three runs to the English skipper!

Keep it there, his bowling coach might be saying just about now! Another full length delivery outside off, Cook is patient enough to shoulder arms once again. A cat and mouse game could begin here, between Cook and Amir!
A teasing delivery, asking Cook to drive the ball. He doesn't oblige, just lets it through to Sarfraz! Amir needs to bowl more often in this channel.
FOUR! Poor misfield, gives Cook an easy boundary! Fullish on the pads, Cook accepts the gift and flicks the ball wide of fine leg. Sohail khan runs across, dives but the ball goes through him.

FOUR! TRADEMARK SHOT FROM ROOT! Back of a length delivery outside off, Root rocks back and punches it elegantly through the covers and the ball races to the boundary. There's no stopping that one. Root is timing the ball really well!
A delivery in the similar channel, a bit wider. Root does not bother to play at it.
Good length delivery outside off, Root watches it carefully and lets it go through to the keeper.
FOUR! LUCKY FOR ROOT! A tad back of a length delivery just outside off, Root looks to square cut it but the ball takes the inside of his bat and goes past the diving Sarfaraz to the boundary.
Root shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Good length ball around middle, Root goes back and defends it towards mid-wicket. Root is solid in his defence!

Brilliant from Mohammad Amir! Fires in a yorker on middle and off, great shape and excellent inswing there, Joe Root does well to jam his bat down in time and dig it out. It goes off the inside half and to the leg side. A single is taken.
Short of a length delivery on off, cramping Root for room as he rocks back to pull this. Is hit on the body when he misses his pull. Seems to have stung the English run-machine.
Left alone by Root. He's not going to be tempted into playing those. It was bowled on a length, no shot offered.

FOUR! An educated edge. If you look closely he's actually meant that. Length ball angled across, Root leans forward and at the last second, slightly opens the face of the bat. Gets it nicely between the slip cordon and the gully to send it across the ropes for a boundary.
Good length ball pitched outside off, rips off the surface and there's some movement away from Root, he isn't enticed to have a go at that.
Full delivery which is aimed at the stumps, driven down to mid on for nothing.
Length delivery outside off, no shot offered as it's collected by the keeper.
Anything on the pads and Cook will deal with them all day long. It's flicked away through square leg for two good runs.
Length delivery just outside off, slightly fuller too, Alastair bunts this back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and on middle and leg, defended well to keep it out.

FOUR BYES! Straighter length ball on leg, Cook looks to nudge it fine down the leg side but fails to get any connection on it. Initially, it seemed the ball went off the thigh pad but that isn't the case. There was so much movement that it went further down the leg side off the deck. Sarfraz looks to stop it but fails to do so as the ball races away to the ropes behind. Byes signalled by the umpire.
Back of a length delivery just outside off, Cook hops and taps it down into the ground.

On a good length and straying just down the leg side, Root looks to flick it away fine but misses as the ball goes off his thigh pad. There are loud appeals for a caught behind as Sarfraz gobbles it up but the umpire isn't interested.
Angled across the No.3 batsman, good pace too as it's left alone.
Too straight and that's easily dealt with by Root. It's too full and too straight on middle and leg, Root clips this off his pads behind square on the leg side and picks up a couple of runs.
Good length just outside the off stump, Root walks across and blocks it solidly to the off side.
JOE ROOT walks in at No.3.

OUT! HALES DEPARTS! Not completely against the run of play as such but that wasn't really expected. And it came off a good catch too, I think. It happened so quickly. It's pitched full on middle and leg, Alex Hales flicks this uppishly. It's in the air, albeit quite low, and flies to Yasir Shah at mid-wicket. The Pakistani leggie gets really low, gobbles it up and immediately starts celebrating. Hales is in his crease unmoved and isn't too convinced. He thinks it's fallen short. So umpire Bruce Oxenford consults with his partner Erasmus and then takes a decision. The soft decision is out but he still wants to be sure. The decision goes upstairs and the replays aren't conclusive at all. It happened really fast and even the cameras couldn't pick it up. So, the soft signal stays and Hales has to walk back. First wicket down for England.

Hales has been caught at mid-wicket by Yasir Shah. But it's quite unclear whether the catch has been taken cleanly or not. The soft signal is out but the umpire just wants to be sure. So the decision goes upstairs.

Fuller in length from Mohammad Amir and it's pitched outside off, Hales is in two minds as he is about to play this. First wants to play, but then decides against it but is slightly late in doing so. The ball goes off the bat and goes one bounce to gully.

Fuller length delivery around leg, Cook looks to flick this away but is rapped low on the pads. There's a stifled appeal for a leg before but the umpire doesn't respond. Rightly so, the ball pitched outside the line of leg stump.
Outside off, Alex taps it in front of covers and takes a quick run. Very alert and that's good.
Heavy movement there for Sohail Khan, it's on a length and moving away, Safraz Ahmed behind the stumps has to come a long way across to collect it, just in front of first slip actually.
Wider line, he doesn't want to bowl there. It's never going to be bothered with.
Length ball shaping away outside off, nice line but arms are shouldered to this one.
Back of a length delivery on off, cramping Hales for room here, he however does well to lean back a bit and defend.
Tailing away from the left-hander as it's pitched slightly fullish in length, left alone by the English skipper to end the over.

FOUR! GOOD SHOT BY COOK! And it's nicely placed too. On a good length and pitched outside off, Cook opens the face of the bat and steers it past the slip cordon and gully fielder all the way to the third man boundary.
Darted well outside off once more, the southpaw isn't remotely interested in playing at that.
Much better from Amir. He tightens the line more and bowls it around off, Cook has to play at it this time and he does well to work it softly to the on side.
Brings it in this time, but it's still well out, Alastair leaves it be.
Amir with a length ball which is really wide outside off, almost near the wide line, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Another delivery which is just short of a length, Cook does well here. Hops and taps it to the off side, calls for a quick single as Hales responds. Get it comfortably.
Angles a back of a length delivery across Alastair Cook, he hops and taps it down into the track ahead. No trouble there.

Touch fuller in length and aimed at off stump, Hales stands his ground and with a beautiful straight bat, taps it to the on side. Gets a call from his partner and a quick single is taken. Good running between the wickets.
Length delivery in the corridor outside off, once again Hales leaves it alone. He wants to play at those but is keeping himself disciplined here. Well done so far.
Keeps the line tight as he pitches it on a length, just outside off, Hales has nothing to do with it.

Good line from Sohail Khan. Bowls this on a good length and in the channel just outside off, gets some zip off the surface as well, Hales looks to dab this away to the off side but fails to get any connection on the ball.
Pitches it up, outside off and going away, not close enough though to draw a shot from the English skipper. End of the over.
Well outside off here, once again it's going away, shorter in length as well, AC withdraws his bat and doesn't bother with it.

FOUR! Too straight and that's punished! Straying on the pads, Cook just stays back and tucks it fine down the leg side to send it all the way to the boundary line. Easy pickings for a player of his quality.
Good length ball outside off, it's getting some real nice carry here, it shapes away a shade from the left-hander as he lets it be.
Another one bowled fuller in length, well outside off, enough that Alastair leans forward and drives it through the covers. Times it sweetly and gets a couple of runs for it.
Amir once again runs in with good rhythm, fires it in full and outside off, a lot of away movement for it, Cook is watchful as he leaves that one alone.
Back of a length delivery, Cook guides it through mid-wicket to retain the strike.
Cook defends it gently down the ground.
LEG BYE! Angled into the pads, bounces a bit extra. Hales again goes for the flick but misses it and the ball thuds into his pads and rolls to the leg side.

FOUR! WELL TIMED BY HALES! Good length delivery around off, shaping away.  Hales stands tall in his crease and strikes it sweetly through the covers and the ball rolls on to the boundary. The fielder at covers gave a good chase but failed to stop the boundary!
Good length delivery, angling in. Hales goes for the flick but misses it and the ball hits him on the thigh pads
Full delivery around middle and leg, Cook stands in his crease and flicks it nicely through mid-wicket. The batsmen come back for three runs.
SOHAIL KHAN will bowl from the other end.
Fullish in length from Mohammad Amir and pitched just outside off, Hales strides forward and drives it to the left of the bowler. Good first over from the left-armer, positive start.
Length ball on off, Hales camps back and bunts it back in the direction of the bowler.

APPEAL FOR A CAUGHT BEHIND! It's looks really close but a good call by the umpire. On an excellent length just around off, coming in nicely and it's almost aimed at off stump. Hales stays back and looks to chop it away to the off side but misses the ball. There's a sound though as the ball passes the batsman and there are loud appeals for a caught behind. Umpire Erasmus isn't interested as he says no. Replays show why, the bat hit the pad and not the ball. Was a really sharp call, that.

And he's off the mark. It's pitched up this time by Amir, it's outside off as Alastair Cook lunges forward and pushes it gently in front of covers. Immediately sets off for a single as he scurries to the other end.
Another length ball in the channel outside off, good line and a lovely seam position, no shot offered there by Cook.
Amir comes steaming in, starts off with a good length delivery outside off, good movement there and some nice carry as well. Cook leans forward and shoulders his arms to it.

We are all set to get underway now as Alastair Cook and Alex Hales make their way out to the middle of the pitch. Pakistan huddle up and talk their strategy over as they now spread out all across the ground. It will be Mohammad Amir to take the new ball first up. 4 slips and a gully in place. It's overcast out there and there's a nice breeze bowling. Let's roll, folks...
The players of both teams are out and are standing in a cue as there is a moment's silence for those who had lost their lives in the recent bombings in Quetta.

MISBAH-UL-HAQ says they were also planning on batting first. Thinks that overall it's a good pitch and maybe later on it will turn quite a bit, so they will have to bowl well and try to take them early. (On team changes) Mohammad Hafeez and Rahat Ali are out for Wahab Riaz and Iftikar Ahmed, who will make his debut. States that it is important in Test cricket to have an extra bowler as bowlers usually get tired and that can hurt you. Says that if you have any other option then it makes things easy for me and Yasir as you need somebody to bowl in between and rotate, but you cannot just bring any part timer.

ALASTAIR COOK says he will have a bat first. Says he gave it a long and hard thought and it's pretty clear now. Explains that if they are able to negotiate the first hour it will be good to bat on. Exclaims there's a good tinge of grass and later on it is going to turn a bit. Mentions that he would like to bring spin into the equation but there's no place for Adil Rashid in the side and so they are unchanged. Adds he doesn't think the ball will reverse, it may towards the end of Day 4 but it will mostly be dry. Further adds his side will try to bat first and put up a big score. (When asked about the No.1 ranking) He says that they are going to try to play well here and put in a good performance.
ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST!

It's all to play for here, for both teams. One looking to go for glory, the other to come to the fore and rise up to the challenge. Pakistan especially will be determined, as they were in a dominating position and primed to clinch to win the last match. But the England pacers haunted them with the reverse swing and took the match by storm. This is the last Test of the English summer and it's poised to be a cracker. Literally! So stay tuned as the all-important toss is about to come up.

After being run through by Pakistan at Lord's, England have made a stupendous comeback and now lead the series 2-1 as they come back to London. A win here, and certain other results going their way, can see the home side going top of the Test rankings, and we all know just how much they enjoy that No.1 spot, don't we? But then, so can the visiting team if they manage to level the series. It's been a real baller of a series so far here and every match has provided some glorious entertainment. Test cricket has finally come into its own and it doesn't get any better than this.
